Using creative, data-driven perspectives, I bring clarity to complex problems. 

I recently graduated summa cum laude from St. Olaf College, with Distinction in Quantitative Economics. While developing my academic skills, I worked on a consulting project for NASA, delivered lectures as a Teaching Assistant in the Economics Department, and served in leadership positions for campus organizations, including the St. Olaf Band and Environmental Coalition. Across academic and professional experiences, I have consistently exhibited strong organizational thinking, effective leadership, and detail-oriented technical expertise in service of a larger vision.
